title: Binance Adds HNT, PAXG Cross Margin Pairs and FIRO, PAXG on Isolated Margin
text: Fellow Binancians, Binance has added new  HNT and PAXG  trading pairs on  Cross Margin , and  FIRO   and   PAXG  as new borrowable assets on   Isolated Margin . New Cross Margin Pairs:  HNT/BUSD, PAXG/BUSD New Isolated Margin Pairs:  FIRO/BUSD, PAXG/BUSD Please refer to  Margin Data  for a list of the most updated marginable assets and further information on specific limits and rates. Further information: What is Margin Trading How to Short on Margin Trading How to Long on Margin Trading Thanks for your support!
